secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Your Supabase project URL (e.g. https://xxxxxxxx.supabase.co) from the Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > Project URL. Currently overridden by a local PostgREST proxy — remove the override in docker-compose.base44.yml when the real project is restored.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Your Supabase project anon/public key from the Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API > Project API keys (anon public). Currently overridden by a local JWT — remove the override in docker-compose.base44.yml when the real project is restored.
